name: amenity-list
title: Amenity list
description: What a place offers as an icon grid of amenities, sorted under headings, with a 'Show all 24 amenities' toggle for the long tail.
docs: amenities is { id, label, icon?, available?, note?, group? }[]: icon is an element drawn at 20px (<IconWifi />), and without one the item shows a check. An amenity with available: false is struck through, says Not included to the eye and, as hidden text, to a screen reader, and keeps its note after it. The first visibleCount (default 8, in reading order) show; the rest sit behind a toggle that says how many there are in all (Show all 24 amenities) and reports aria-expanded and aria-controls. With no more than visibleCount items there is no toggle. groups is { id, label }[]: the amenities are sorted under those headings in that order, a heading is drawn as soon as one of its items shows, and amenities whose group is missing or unknown go under Other. expanded (or defaultExpanded) and onExpandedChange control the toggle. labels carries every word, with {count} filled in.
